formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with prominent buffers Lauryl Glucoside (3) and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate (4, mild anionic); no reinforcing route -> moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: prominent cationic Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride (6). C2 not met; no other route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: It is the only conditioning ingredient; no silicone, lipid, refatter, protein or humectant - a single polymer could read as low.

weightPotential.rationale: A single cationic starch polymer with no reinforcing route, facing an effective C1 reset.

persistence.rationale: Starch-based cationic, no silicone/lipid to carry.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with glucoside and sarcosinate buffers (C1 moderate).

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light family with ordinary reset; no polymer floor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Only one deposition family, no reinforcing route, facing moderate reset (W2 permits low); nothing else could converge.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only candidate: scalp_active (Piroctone Olamine 7, needs an E2 dandruff claim); menthol cooling; no lengths-care route.

usageRole.rationale: Default; treatment if a qualifying dandruff claim is revealed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA not met: no E4 comfort or humectant route in positions 1-8. Counter-signal: prominent Menthol (8).
